Name: Dr. Moon
Description: Little is known about the early life of the man who goes by the name Doctor Moon. Indeed it is suspected that his title is unearned as no record of his accreditation can be found. "Genius can neither be confirmed or denied by a piece of paper" says Moon. In his mind, the acquisition of knowledge was more important than moral ethics. Dr. Moon is easily the Asian equivalent of the infamous Nazi surgeon Dr. Joseph Mengele.
